name: census-root-hygiene
brief: Six source-scanning test files under src/renderer/src take their scan root from process.cwd(), so a run whose cwd is a different valid checkout silently measures the wrong tree: the existing non-empty guards only tell 'a tree' from 'no tree'. This session re-roots all six on their own import.meta.url (without a static node: import, which tsconfig.web.json's types: [] and the renderer hygiene forbid), adds a per-file guard that fails with a root-mismatch message when the scanned tree is not the tree containing the file, and adds a repo-level guard against reintroducing a process.cwd() root. The discriminating instrument is a run with cwd in the main checkout and --root on the session worktree, where today's code passes while reading the wrong tree. Bundled into hygiene.test.ts: the BORDER_PROPERTIES docblock/constant mismatch over logical border forms, a retired-test-id exemption that proves purpose rather than presence, and four prose counts corrected to figures measured at 10feee6^ and at HEAD. Suite and repo-wide typecheck stay green.
